## What ran

The same rollback, under three identity models: **A** shared service account, **B** user token (impersonation), **C** delegation chain. Held constant: the incident (payment-service, 14% errors, the Datadog event dd-evt-771204); the proposed rollback (payment-service, production, v4.18.0 → v4.17.2); the logical agents and their deterministic plans; the policy fixture (config/policies.yaml); the approval fixture (ic.dev approves the exact call); the tool simulators and their logs (aid/tools.py); the run configuration; the nine attribution questions; the scenarios. The only variable: identity propagation and credential architecture.

## I2 · The confused deputy

`agent.release-guard` (read only) asks `agent.incident-intel` to roll back production.

| Identity model | First decision | Rule | Approver saw | Originator visible | Rollbacks |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Shared account | REQUIRE_APPROVAL | P2-high-risk-production | agent.incident-intel | ✗ | 1 |
| User token | REQUIRE_APPROVAL | P2-high-risk-production | agent.incident-intel | ✗ | 1 |
| Delegation chain | DENY | P1-missing-scope | (no approval requested) | ✓ | 0 |

Delegation chain: caller scopes `deploy:read, itsm:read, release:check, telemetry:read`; callee scopes after narrowing
`deploy:read, itsm:read, telemetry:read`; actor chain `agent.incident-intel@1.3.0 → agent.release-guard@0.9.2`; an undeclared agent → agent
edge refused: ✓.

| Id | Check | Kind | Arm | Result |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| I2-01 | chain: the deputy request is denied before any approval | invariant | C | pass |
| I2-02 | chain: the callee's scopes narrowed | invariant | C | pass |
| I2-03 | chain: an undeclared agent -> agent edge is refused | invariant | C | pass |
| I2-04 | shared account: the deputy rollback executes and hides its originator | control | A | pass |

## I3 · Revocation: one lever, five running executions

Executions: **E1** event -> incident-intel; **E2** maya (web) -> incident-intel; **E3** ci -> release-guard (release-runtime); **E4** workflow -> incident-intel; **E5** maya (web) -> incident-intel -> remediation. Each lever was pulled at minute
5 of a 30-minute window; execution tokens live 15 minutes.

| Lever | Stopped | Kept running | Minutes to effect | New start afterwards |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| agent | E1, E2, E4, E5 | E3 | E1 0, E2 0, E4 0, E5 0 | refused: agent agent.incident-intel@1.3.0 is disabled |
| delegation | E2, E5 | E1, E3, E4 | E2 10, E5 10 | accepted |
| invoker credential | E1 | E2, E3, E4, E5 | E1 10 | refused: unknown or revoked credential |
| tool identity | E5 | E1, E2, E3, E4 | E5 0 | accepted |
| workload | E1, E2, E4, E5 | E3 | E1 0, E2 0, E4 0, E5 0 | accepted |
| shared account rotation | E1, E2, E3, E4, E5 | none | E1 0, E2 0, E3 0, E4 0, E5 0 | accepted |

| Id | Check | Kind | Arm | Result |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| I3-01 | control: nothing stops without a revocation | invariant | C | pass |
| I3-02 | delegation: only Maya's executions stop, within one token lifetime | qualified | C | pass |
| I3-03 | invoker credential: new executions from that head refused | invariant | C | pass |
| I3-04 | agent: every execution running that agent stops at its next call | invariant | C | pass |
| I3-05 | workload: executions on the other runtime keep running | invariant | C | pass |
| I3-06 | tool identity: one capability of one execution stops | invariant | C | pass |
| I3-07 | shared account rotation stops all five executions | control | A | pass |

## Supported, qualified, contradicted

Every declared check passed, so nothing contradicted an expectation (0 failed). The checks of kind *qualified* hold only within a bound: I3-02 (delegation: only Maya's executions stop, within one token lifetime), I4-05 (stolen tool credential dies with its ten minutes). Each claim's status, and the qualified findings that are not a check (a stolen tool credential works at its one audience until it expires; the tool log holds only the edge; the hash chain is not an anchored ledger; I6 is derived from configuration), are in the [Evidence Check](agent-identity-evidence.html).

## Reproduce

```bash
cd agent_identity_poc && uv sync --group dev
uv run pytest                                          # 34 tests, including test_experiments.py (I1–I7, G01–G11)
uv run aid experiments --run-id 2026-10-03-recorded       # refuses if a frozen file changed
cd .. && make verify                                   # rerun into a fresh copy; byte for byte
```
